hotspots.title: Trump Midterm Rally Frenzy
hotspots.blurb: President Trump’s whirlwind of rallies across the South has drawn massive crowds, heated protests, and a surge of media attention, framing the midterms as a personal crusade.
hotspots.affect: The rally circuit is portrayed as a battle‑zone with outsized praise from supporters and stark backlash from opponents, creating a high‑stakes narrative.

hotspots.title: Norway Fuel‑Tax Cut & Immigration Alert
hotspots.blurb: A coalition of Frp, Sp and KrF pushed a year‑long fuel‑tax cut while Fremskrittspartiet warned of a looming surge in non‑Western immigration, sparking a heated policy clash.
hotspots.affect: The dual focus on cheaper fuel and a dramatic immigration forecast fuels moral panic and partisan fighting over the nation’s future.

hotspots.title: Sweden Democrats Reject Sami Truth Commission
hotspots.blurb: The Sweden Democrats publicly refused the Sami Truth Commission’s demand for a state apology, igniting cultural backlash and accusations of historical denial.
hotspots.affect: The stance is cast as an affront to indigenous rights, provoking moral outrage and intra‑party identity battles.

hotspots.title: ICE Threats Over Polling Places

hotspots.affect: The narrative pits voter suppression fears against claims of law‑and‑order, inflaming alarm and partisan fury.

hotspots.title: Economic Grievances: Trump’s Rate Claims & Medicare Checks
hotspots.blurb: Trump’s public criticism of interest rates and the rollout of $90 checks for seniors have become focal points for debates over economic competence and populist giveaways.
hotspots.affect: These moves are framed as either bold leadership or reckless populism, generating sharp partisan divide and financial anxiety.
